reason_definitions.company_response_invalid: Company response is not an object.
reason_definitions.company_symbol_mismatch: Company response does not include the requested symbol.
reason_definitions.filing_before_period_end: A filing date precedes its fiscal period end.
reason_definitions.fiscal_year_duplicate: Annual statements contain a duplicate fiscal year.
reason_definitions.fiscal_year_fallback: A fiscal year was inferred from a validated period date.
reason_definitions.fiscal_year_gap: At least one fiscal year is missing from the returned range.
reason_definitions.no_usable_consecutive_pair: No consecutive usable annual pair exists.
reason_definitions.price_duplicate_timestamp: Price observations contain a duplicate timestamp.
reason_definitions.price_end_stale: Price coverage ends more than seven days before execution.
reason_definitions.price_gap_large: A calendar gap between prices exceeds seven days.
reason_definitions.price_observation_invalid: At least one price observation is invalid.
reason_definitions.price_response_invalid: Price response has an invalid shape.
reason_definitions.price_start_late: Price coverage starts more than 31 days after requested.
reason_definitions.price_symbol_mismatch: Price response symbol differs from the request.
reason_definitions.statement_history_short: Fewer than five annual statements were returned.
reason_definitions.statement_response_invalid: Statement response is not a list.
reason_definitions.statement_row_invalid: At least one annual statement row is malformed.
